diagnostics.message: :data.http.wait_for_cluster: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The explicit dependency from :data.http.wait_for_cluster to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.this duplicates the endpoint and certificate_authority attribute references already establishing that dependency.

The aws_eks_cluster.this resource should wait for the service-linked-role-creation policy attachment so EKS has permission to create the ELB service-linked role when provisioning load balancers; no dependency currently orders the cluster after this attachment.
